_readme: KNOCK, KNOCK — effects settings. Edit this file to customize the house.
Each set (boo, scary, booscary, funny) is a list of effects. The FizzBuzz answer picks the set; a shuffle bag picks which effect.

files: video = your big background video (.mp4), poster = still image shown until the first knock. startOnKnock: true starts the video on the first knock. videoSound: true plays the video's own audio (your song is in the video). loop: true loops it. song: optional separate .mp3 (leave empty if the song is in the video).
on: true/false switches an effect in or out of the rotation.
line: the text shown when it plays. Change it to anything you like.
extra: true lets it also pop up as a bonus effect layered on other scares.
effect: which built-in animation to run. You can move any effect to any set, or use the same effect twice with different lines (give each its own id).

Built-in effects: peek, crack, drift, bleed, frost, prints, lamp, words, candles, knockback, shadow, attic, swarm, spider, ferns, wisps, crows, blood, rot, burst, flood, grab, storm, parade, band, dirge, coffin, roofline, bonegang, conga, dormer, peekaboo, rise, breath
combo: how many bonus extras layer on top of each set's main scare (0 = none).
script: force a specific effect id on a specific knock, e.g. "3": "vampire". Only applies to knocks that are already scares.
plainLines: what the house says on plain-number knocks. {n} is replaced with the knock number.

door: a transparent picture standing behind the door (needs image; optional hold in ms). Balance tip: over one play of the song you get roughly 21 Boo, 11 Scary and 6 BooScary knocks, so keep each set at or under that if you want every scare findable.
scripted: true keeps a scare out of the random shuffle, so it only plays on its scripted knock (the second line on 15).

nightScares: how many scares make a night (20). Each plays once; then the grand finale (lastScare) comes out and the door locks until it's over. The next knock starts a new night, drawn from the scares this visitor hasn't met yet. The house remembers who you've met in this browser.
lastScare: the id of the scare that ends every night (the grand finale).
plainLines: No Fizz. No Buzz. No candy.
The witch says: LEARN TO DIVIDE!
Even zombies know how to divide!
The vampire says: YOU SUCK AT MATH!
The skeleton has more digits than you!
The house says: TRY A NUMBER!
No Fizz. No Buzz. Just shame.
The mummy wants his number back!
Your math is giving us nightmares!
The bats are better at division!
The witch just rolled her eyes.
The skeleton says: DO THE MATH!

boo.line: The door opens a crack. Something looks back.
Someone just walked past the window.
Tap, tap, tap. Someone wants your attention.
Good evening. The master will see you… never.
The party's inside and frightenly festive.
The Baby Dolls are out tonight.
Pumpkin Pete is losing his head.
Supper's on. Don't ask what's in it.

scary.line: The bats know you're here now.
The garden is growing dead heads.
The crows have come to watch.
WHO IS STANDING ON THE PATH?
THE BONE GANG IS OUT TONIGHT.
THE CHORUS LINE IS ON THE ROOF.
The garden is giving up its dead.

booscary.line: THE BAND IS COMING BACK AROUND.
A JAZZ FUNERAL… FOR THE LIVING.
THE WHOLE CLUB CAME OUT FOR YOU.
